_description: Rise FC standalone schema operator — contract schema defining the required shape of a Claude QA finding record. This is a contract definition only. No QA has been run. No findings exist. No QA zips have been created.
_nonAuthorizationStatement: This schema does not authorize schema output, production deployment, or any implementation action. Claude QA is a reviewer only — it is not a source of truth.

findingRecord._description: Shape of a single Claude QA finding record. All fields are required unless marked optional.

findingId.description: Unique identifier for this finding within the run.

runId.description: Identifies the governed run this finding belongs to.

descriptions.BLOCKER: Finding prevents schema from being used at all. Must be resolved before any further review.
descriptions.HIGH: Serious defect that must be resolved before operator approval. Not implementation-blocking by itself but requires controller decision.
descriptions.MEDIUM: Notable issue that should be addressed. May be resolved in patch or deferred with documented rationale.
descriptions.LOW: Minor issue or style concern. May be accepted with documented acknowledgement.
descriptions.INFO: Informational observation. No action required but recorded for operator awareness.

descriptions.SOURCE_TRUTH: Finding relates to Phase 0 source truth — incorrect derivation, invented field, or truth fingerprint mismatch.
descriptions.HELD_FIELD: Finding relates to a held field being emitted without approval or with insufficient evidence.
descriptions.BLOCKED_MODULE: Finding relates to a blocked schema module appearing in the output bundle.
descriptions.JSONLD_VALIDITY: Finding relates to JSON-LD syntax, context, graph structure, or lint rule (JLSR_001–JLSR_010).
descriptions.EVIDENCE_MAP: Finding relates to the evidence map — missing evidence, weak evidence, or invented evidence.
descriptions.VALIDATOR_RESULT: Finding relates to an external validator result (Schema.org Validator, Google Rich Results Test, Screaming Frog).
descriptions.ASTRO_CARRY: Finding relates to Astro schema carry or attachment (Mode 2 only).
descriptions.CURRENT_SITE_IMPLEMENTATION: Finding relates to the current website implementation (Mode 1 only).
descriptions.DOCUMENTATION: Finding relates to package documentation, workflow docs, or operator materials.
descriptions.OTHER: Finding does not fit another category. Requires description.

sourceFile.description: The file path within the output bundle or package that contains the issue. Use relative path from repo root.

sourcePath.description: Optional JSON path or section within the sourceFile that pinpoints the finding.

claim.description: Plain-language statement of what the finding is. What is wrong, missing, or noteworthy. Must not invent schema facts.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence for the finding — e.g. quoted text from the file, field value, rule reference. Must trace to actual file content, not invented.

ruleReference.description: Optional reference to a governing rule, lint rule, or doctrine section that this finding relates to.

recommendation.description: Claude QA recommendation for how to resolve the finding. This is advisory only — the controller makes the final decision.

controllerDisposition.description: Filled in by the controller after reviewing this finding. Not set by Claude QA.

descriptions.ACCEPTED: Controller accepts the finding and applies the recommendation.
descriptions.MODIFIED: Controller applies a modified version of the recommendation.
descriptions.REJECTED: Controller rejects the finding with documented rationale.
descriptions.DEFERRED: Controller defers the finding to a later run or PR.
descriptions.HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Controller escalates to human review before proceeding.
descriptions.PATCH_REQUIRED: Finding requires a patch before the output bundle can proceed.

controllerRationale.description: Controller's documented rationale for the disposition. Required when controllerDisposition is REJECTED or DEFERRED.

findingSetShape._description: Shape of a complete Claude QA finding set for a single governed run.

qaRunId.description: Identifies this QA review run. Matches the targetRunId in the controller review packet.

qaSessionId.description: Identifies the Claude session used for QA. Must be a fresh session — Claude QA must run with no prior context from the schema generation session.

truthFingerprint.description: The truth fingerprint of the source truth used for this run. Must match the locked homepage fingerprint for homepage runs.

totalFindings.description: Total number of findings in this set.

findings.description: Array of finding records conforming to findingRecord shape above.

qaRecommendation.description: Claude QA overall recommendation for this finding set. Advisory only — controller makes the final decision.

nonAuthorizationStatement.description: Must state that Claude QA does not authorize schema output, production deployment, or any implementation action.
